changes.title: She Voted for a Justice Who Overturned Roe. Now it Haunts Her on the Trail.
changes.summary: Senator Susan Collins, who supports abortion rights, endorsed Brett Kavanaugh’s nomination for the Supreme Court. It has emerged as a major issue in her campaign for re-election.

changes.title: Trump’s Global Tariffs: What’s the Latest on the Trade War
changes.summary: The president has unveiled a complicated system to forge ahead with his trade war, after the Supreme Court struck down his original levies.

changes.title: Trump imposes double-digit tariffs on dozens of countries as stopgap 10% levies expire Friday
changes.summary: President Donald Trump is going ahead with new double-digit tariffs on dozens of U.S. trading partners just as the clock runs out Friday on stopgap levies he imposed after a stinging defeat at the Supreme Court.

changes.title: Supreme Court Turbocharges Presidential Power
changes.summary: A pair of decisions reshaped the structure of the federal government.

changes.title: Trump Administration to Impose New Tariffs on Brazil
changes.summary: The United States accused the country of unfair trade practices. The tariff will replace ones that the Supreme Court struck down.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: Justices Elena Kagan and Amy Coney Barrett testified before Congress as the nation's highest court looks to increase security funding in the wake of threats. It's the first time Supreme Court justices have appeared before Congress since 2019. Congressional correspondent Lisa Desjardins reports.
